title: drymocallis regisborisii
intro: Drymocallis regisborisii, commonly known as Queen's cup, is a perennial plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Drymocallis regisborisii are attributed to its ability to act as a mild laxative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, which may help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Drymocallis regisborisii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
